assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia.
The patient has a diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome.
A cardiac event monitor is ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and evaluate for potential embolic sources.
The CPT code for the service is 93271.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-97.
